neighbours.label: ' because' or an explanatory ' when', giving the reason for a fact (We have seasons because..., Rainbows appear when...), as opposed to although, and to ' when' for a time
fire: We have tides because the moon pulls on the sea.
Thunder rolls across the sky when lightning heats the air.
It was because he had found out about the money.
She chose the old house because it had a garden.
Ice floats because it is less dense than water.
Leaves turn red when the green pigment breaks down.
He left the firm because of the long hours.
Metals expand when they are heated.
quiet: We have tides although the moon is far from the sea.
Thunder rolled across the sky and the kids went in.
It was after he had found out about the money.
She chose the old house, and it had a garden.
Ice floats, but it is less dense than water.
Please call me when you reach the station.
He left the firm in spite of the long hours.
We will eat when they arrive.

notes: German 'weil' reached only 0.20 in a probe, and is left out. ' when' for a time stayed at 0.03.
